news.title: Math education finds home in newly-renovated space
news.summary_en: Students taking classes in math education this semester will find a new space for their studies. Room 3017 in the Wright Education building was recently redesigned to meet the needs of today’s future math educators, a project three years in the making.

news.title: Scholarship encourages alumni to come together to support current students
news.summary_en: A group of past and present members of the IU School of Education’s Alumni Board came together to create the School of Education Alumni Board Endowed Scholarship, which is awarded annually to undergraduate students.
